issue.title: Restore editing headroom in the bob-mac-capture task-pickers reference page
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-ly.5 note #1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), triaged by the bob-cli-ly land agent.

bob-mac-capture `docs/task-pickers.md` is mounted into Bob's site as a reference page with the 6,000-word cap (bob-cli `tools/docs/bob_docs/lint.py`). Measured with `bob_docs.markdown.count_words`:

- 5,951 words at bob-mac-capture 19e4c404 (before epic bob-cli-ly);
- 5,997 at 5bc9478f (bob-cli-ly.4 added a three-line `## Go To Notes Picker` pointer to `go-to-notes.md`);
- 5,999 at master 898b8215.

`just docs-check` on bob-cli 122c7fcf passes, so nothing fails today, but any further edit to the page (Go To, Move, Block ID, Parent Task pickers) must trim first. The page also carries doubled `## Task Link Picker` and `## Parent Task Picker` headings (lines ~49/51 and ~137/139) worth checking while editing.

Remedy: condense duplicated prose or move one coherent section (for example the Block ID Picker or Move card subsections) to its own page under the docs routing rules, leaving at least ~300 words of headroom, without dropping behavior, keys, or contract links, and without raising the cap. Preserve inbound anchors or update callers (bob-mac-capture docs, nav.yml, bob-cli docs). Use `sase repo open bob-mac-capture`, read its AGENTS.md and bob-cli docs memory first, run `just docs-check` in both repos, and follow the bob-mac-capture commit + exact-SHA macOS CI loop.

task_type_fields.proposal: Give bob-mac-capture docs/task-pickers.md at least ~300 words of editing headroom under the 6,000-word mounted reference cap by condensing prose or moving one coherent picker section to its own page.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The page was already at 5,951 words before epic bob-cli-ly, which added only a 48-word pointer and passes docs-check; reorganizing unrelated picker documentation is outside the Go To Notes epic.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-ly.5 proposed it after the Go To Notes pointer left docs/task-pickers.md at 5,999 of 6,000 mounted reference words; the shortage predates the epic (5,951), so it is a distinct capacity task like bob-cli-il.
